name: AutoMV
abstract: AutoMV turns a full song into a coherent music video with a multi-agent system — and ships the first music-to-video evaluation benchmark: four categories and twelve expert criteria, with an LLM judge that tracks professional raters. TokenWave anchors the Audio & Video Editor career to it.
contributions: The first open benchmark for music-to-video quality: Music Content, Technical, Post-production, and Art, refined into twelve criteria scored 1–5.
LLM-Score, an automatic judge whose ratings largely align with independent musicians and music-industry professionals.
A generation system to match: screenwriter and director agents, a character bank for identity consistency, and a verifier that sends failed shots back for regeneration.
method: Evaluation runs on 30 professionally released songs across English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
Expert raters watch full videos with audio and score every sub-criterion; LLM-Score approximates the same rubric automatically.
Cross-system comparison also reports audio-visual alignment via ImageBind score.

metrics.name: ImageBind score
metrics.note: Audio-visual alignment between the generated video and the song; the paper's cross-system comparison metric.

leaderboard_note: Rows are generation systems, not base models; scores from the paper's cross-system comparison on the 30-song set.
